training_data: 24 main-design user tasks and 96 injection pairs
test_data: 8 frozen task-disjoint confirmation tasks and 32 injection pairs
fit_rule: refit the main OOF-selected model once on all main-design outcomes, with no confirmation labels used for fitting or selection
primary_endpoint: selected minus comparator mean attack/utility within-task pairwise accuracy
supportive_endpoint: selected minus comparator mean pair soft-label Brier score

interpretation.directional_replication: pairwise accuracy difference greater than 0 and Brier difference no greater than 0.01
interpretation.strong_replication: pairwise accuracy difference 95% task-bootstrap lower bound greater than 0 and Brier difference no greater than 0.01
interpretation.otherwise: confirmation does not support a general improvement claim
